content.title: Nyctophobia
about: Nyctophobia is a horror-themed 3D environment project inspired by Outlast. The level recreates and connects four key areas (dormitories, main hall, chapel, and kitchen/dining) to form a coherent exploration route with progression gates (keys/cards).

Built as a team project for the 3D Scenes course at CITM (UPC). My contributions focused on the main hall layout, night-vision implementation, interaction scripting (doors, pickups, sprinklers), and VFX particles (sparks and dust).
features: Interconnected level layout with exploration routes and progression gates
Lighting study with contrast and focal points to guide player navigation
Night-vision effect implemented with custom shaders and toggling controls
Interactable doors, pickups, and scripted sprinklers to change the environment
Custom particles (sparks and dust) and performance work (Occlusion Culling)
learnings: Using lighting and landmarks to support player orientation in a horror space
Implementing reusable interaction scripts (doors, pickups, triggers) for level logic
Creating readable VFX with particles and shaders while keeping performance under control
